source.title: An 8-to-12-Bit Resolution-Reconfigurable SAR ADC With Fast-Window-Switching Technique (Liang, Song, Zhu, TCAS-II 2025)
modifications: None to final.scs. The netlist is the analog core only (dual-reference differential CDAC capacitors + dynamic comparator with SR latch). Bootstrap switches, resolution switches RSP/RSN, reference switches and the SAR/FWS logic are NOT in the netlist: the testbench adds them as fixed behavioural instrumentation (Verilog-A sequencer, recipes/sar_ext.py).

known_issues: VXP_MSB / VXP_MID (and the N side) are separate top-plate pins in the netlist: the resolution switches RSP1/RSP2 are not in it; the 12-bit mode (all switches on) is modelled by 10 ohm resistors tying them to VXP / VXN.
The comparator's latch devices (MPH_*, MNR_*, MPL_*, MNL_*, MND_*, MP_/MN_COP/CON) have 1 um / 1 um placeholder sizes in the netlist (paper: not reported).
